before_results.readmission: Positive class is a patient readmitted within 30 days. A missed positive matters more than a false alarm. Both errors are bad, but a missed patient who needs more treatment and doesn't receive it can get worse, and the health problem can grow bigger while going untreated.
before_results.diabetes: Positive class is a doctor diagnosis of diabetes or HbA1c of 6.5% or higher. A missed positive matters more than a false alarm. If a patient's diabetes goes untreated it can worsen, and they could die several years later from complications; a patient who is treated has a much lower chance of dying.
